#!/bin/sh
set -eu
backing=/var/lib/lvm-loop/data-pv.img
if ! losetup -j "$backing" | grep -q .; then
    losetup --find --show "$backing" >/dev/null
fi
vgchange -ay vg_data >/dev/null
mkdir -p /srv/data
if ! mountpoint -q /srv/data; then
    mount /srv/data
fi
mountpoint -q /srv/data
